saw_lines: Nail care buyers want proof before trust, so they pick the treatment a podiatrist names, then finish the full course.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where proof and the offer must show before the scroll ends.
Your site says over 11,000 customers approved your treatments, but 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Put 11,000 on the creative and open two ads with a customer review.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site says over 11,000 customers approved your treatments, but 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so new buyers never get the reason. Put 11,000 on the creative and open two ads with a short customer review.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 24 copy ads mention any offer, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put 10% off the first order in line one of every new ad and on the creative.
Your 24 copy ads use 16 openings, so no single story builds up. Pick the two most used openers, the 3 seconds a day line and the 3 second nail routine, and build the next batch from only those two.

2 ads have run 60+ days, and the oldest, the summer feet video, has run since July 2026 with no variation of its own. That is proof it works. Build 3 more versions of that video, each with a new first line.

ads_1: Lead new video ads with the 3 second routine and the first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
